description: Forecast for a market (BTC, ETH, XAU, …): main and alternative scenarios with targets and an invalidation level, near-term conditions, the big picture by week/day/4 hours, and price levels. Scenarios are Elliott-wave counts, not probabilities; the share of “similar days” is a past frequency. Analysis / Elliott-wave markup, NOT investment advice. light — status-markup colour (red — the decline outweighs); not a trade signal. lang — ru or en; default en.
name: get_forecast
